nodes.name: ReadTransactions
nodes.role: find the March payment to Spotify in the transaction history

nodes.name: ReadPriceIncrease
nodes.role: read the Spotify price increase notice and determine the new monthly price

nodes.name: ComputeShortfall
nodes.role: work out the difference between the amount that should have been paid for March and the amount actually paid

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: ask the user to approve the shortfall amount and the Spotify payee before any payment is made

nodes.name: PayShortfall
nodes.role: pay the approved shortfall amount to Spotify

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user the payment confirmation and the amount paid
